summary: Project Tharsis is a browser-based 3D survival game inspired by NASA’s InSight mission. Players have ten Martian sols to rebuild Aurora Outpost and complete a marsquake investigation. They must balance mining, power generation, life support, and repairs while surviving meteor showers, tornadoes, dust storms, and electrical storms. To complete the mission, players secure a sample, record seismic activity, and transmit their findings before the relief crew arrives.
details:
Mars Mission · Aurora Outpost is a base-building survival game inspired by NASA’s InSight mission and the Cerberus Fossae region of Mars. In our fictional scenario, a meteor shower interrupts a marsquake investigation. Players have ten Martian sols to rebuild the research outpost, secure sample M01, record seismic activity, and transmit the findings before the relief crew arrives.

The game explores the trade-offs behind keeping a remote research station operational. Players spend the same ore on construction and emergency repairs. Solar power is inexpensive but loses output during storms, making batteries and geothermal generators valuable as the colony grows. Meteor showers, tornadoes, dust storms, and electrical storms put those decisions to the test.

We built the browser game with TypeScript, Preact, PlayCanvas, and Vite. A live dashboard shows resources, power, and structural integrity, while a separate panel tracks construction and scientific objectives. The game defaults to English and also supports Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, and Russian.
